scope: EXACT_PASS = exact reproduction of the declared recomputable artifacts plus verification of preserved published evidence; held-out metrics are not recomputed

amendment.reason: The first clean-clone run failed the original strict policy on two metadata/provenance differences and stopped at the structural failure, so its reports and figures were not compared. (1) The download metadata data/raw/manifest.json differs from the frozen file only in the day of the download (`retrieved`); the raw data files are byte-identical. (2) The GLM training output echoes the config section used at training time and its hash; that training ran before the gradient-boosting block, two bootstrap options and the Lorenz point count were added to the config, so regenerating under the current config gives identical computed numbers but a different echo and hash. The added keys are read only by gbm, freeze and evaluate/report (static evidence below), never by the GLM training modules. (3) The original policy declared the JSON telemetry keys volatile but not their markdown renderings: the timing values (seconds) rendered in the markdown reports, found from the renderer code.
